Lena Ortiz: Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: folks asked for explicit owners and dates for API perf fixes, Console beta, and Optimize recommendation tooling. Can we capture in-thread so I can paste into the digest?

Connor Wu: Eng: API perf split: July canary (kernel + batching), Aug GA. KV/prefix caching later (tentative Sept). I'll own rollout.

Marta Reyes: Product: Console beta plan - closed beta late Oct, public beta early Nov. I'll own comms + beta invites.

Priya Patel: Applied ML: Optimize v1 - internal trials Sept, customer pilots Oct, GA Nov. Need prompt sets and evaluation hooks.

Connor Wu: Runbook/rollback owner: Connor Wu (eng) - will publish playbooks and canary dashboards by 2025-06-26.

Lena Ortiz: Please each drop a single critical dependency (one line) so we can unblock.

Connor Wu: Dependency: validated kernel perf numbers and staging fleet with mixed traffic.

Marta Reyes: Dependency: design signoff on migration UX and docs writer assigned.

Priya Patel: Dependency: labeled prompt sets + eval metrics; access to sample customer data for trials (sanitized).

DevOps-bot: Scheduled: create-canary-dashboard job queued for 2025-06-20 02:00 UTC.

Lena Ortiz: Great. I'll compile and send the all-hands digest with owners + dates today and schedule a 15m sync next week to review blockers. :thumbsup:
